changes: Opt-in services pilot broadens FTS5 retrieval with fixed related search terms; general analysis keeps its existing search mode.
At most two searches, each bounded to 96 matching document candidates and 12 returned fragments; reciprocal rank fusion weights the original query more strongly.
A best fragment per candidate document prevents one long document from occupying all candidate positions. Final fused context has at most eight fragments, preferring distinct documents.
Future judicial candidates are excluded before final context selection; excluded counts refer to observed candidates only.
Document/matter ACL, original text offsets and hashes remain enforced for every retrieved fragment.
Related terms, candidate cap and incomplete-search status are exposed to the model and report. Terms do not assert legal equivalence.

validation.skip_reason: Russian OCR language data not installed.

limits: This is lexical/domain-term retrieval, not embedding-based semantic search.
Candidate caps can omit relevant documents; retrieval does not establish completeness or absence of risks.
The twelve controls test target discovery only, not overall precision or legal correctness.
Real model/search execution is blocked by missing configuration; browser acceptance is blocked by missing Chromium.
Independent lawyer approval, complete legal histories and full case chains remain open.
